correctness.rationale: For f odd with zf′/f=e^{v(z²)}, coefficients are a3=v1/2 and a5=(v1²+v2)/4, so T6=D² with 16D=(4-s)²-w², s=v1² and w=v2, |w|<=1-|s|. Therefore 16|D|>=|4-s|²-|w|² >=(4-t)²-(1-t)²=15-6t>=9 for t=|s|<=1. Equality forces t=1, w=0 and equality |4-s|=4-|s|, so s=1 and Schwarz equality gives v(zeta)=±zeta. This yields |T6|>=81/256 with precisely those extremizers. The matching upper endpoint 625/256 is cited from the full primary article Proposition 5.3, independently confirmed on its original printed p7 and not reclaimed. This proof is analytic for every Schwarz function; no sampling shortcut.
residual_risks: The upper constant is imported from the prior paper, not independently derived here.
